- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — raise forecast lows to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast increases to 5–10% below true peak.
- Lag in price reversal — delay forecast drop by 1–2 days after sentiment shifts to bearish.
- Mean-reversion bias — if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–3% per day until convergence.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen momentum by 15–20% in high-sentiment periods.
